Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
import ctypes,ctypes.util,struct
lib=ctypes.CDLL(ctypes.util.find_library('lz4') or 'liblz4.so.1')
lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_char_p,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int];lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial.restype=ctypes.c_int
for D in [128,160,300]:
 N=86; rem=D-(N+4); final=5; mlen=rem-final
 for off in [1,4,86]:
  if mlen<4: continue
  ext=b''; low=mlen-4
  if low>=15: ext=bytes([low-15]); low=15
  s=bytes([0xf0,N-15])+b'A'*N+b'\x00\x00'+bytes([low])+ext+struct.pack('<H',off)+bytes([final<<4])+b'B'*final
  out=ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'X'*D,D); r=lib.LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(ctypes.create_string_buffer(s),out,len(s),D,D)
  print('D',D,'off',off,'len',len(s),'r',r,'mid',out.raw[N:N+10].hex(),'tail',out.raw[-8:].hex())
PY
